headline: Fifteen degrees under thin high cloud.
body: Temperature has reached fifteen. A south-south-west breeze continues at ten kilometres an hour; pressure holds at one thousand twenty-nine and remains steady. High cloud covers less than half the sky, and the paving stays dry four hours after sunrise.
